en.t: This reply was completely beside the point.

units.source_text: 然而她回思往事，想到那轰动一时的须磨事件毕竟因谁而起，她的心肠便软起来，觉得今日再见一面，有何不可。

en.t: Yet as she thought back over the past and considered who, after all, had caused the once sensational Suma affair, her heart softened, and she felt there was no harm in seeing him once more today.

units.source_text: 原来胧月夜本是一个主意不定的人。

en.t: In truth, Oborozukiyo had always been a person of uncertain resolve.

units.source_text: 虽然近年来学得了种种人情世故，看到公私无数事例，深悔自己往日之轻率，所以一向守身如玉，

en.t: Although in recent years she had learned much about worldly affairs, had seen countless examples in public and private life, and deeply regretted her former rashness, so that she had always kept herself pure,

units.source_text: 但是今夜之会，使她回忆旧情，似觉昔日之事近在目前，便不能坚贞自守了。

en.t: this meeting tonight brought back her old feelings, made the events of the past seem close before her eyes, and she could no longer hold fast to her chastity.
